claims.claim: PSEG is pairing regulated grid investment with 3,758 MW of carbon-free baseload nuclear capacity; Q2 highlighted 10,446 MW peak load and demand-response activation during heatwaves.
Management reaffirmed 6%-8% long-term non-GAAP operating earnings growth through 2030 and a $24B-$28B five-year capital program.

risks.risk: Large capital program carries financing, regulatory and execution exposure.

unknowns.unknown: Timing and economics of prospective multi-year nuclear output contracts remain unknown.

claims.claim: Q2 non-GAAP operating earnings rose to $425M from $384M and six-month operating cash flow rose to $1.821B from $1.527B.
PSE&G restored nearly all of roughly 380,000 storm-affected customers within 24 hours, providing operational evidence for resilience investment.

risks.risk: Higher depreciation and interest expense accompany incremental investment.

unknowns.unknown: Future rate-case recovery and financing mix for the expanded capex plan require Alpha underwriting.
